pages.text: Dormant flakes hold a little of what the Stillness has suspended. They are raw material, not active essence.
pages.title: What remains
Stored change
pages.text: The Stillness Dynamo accepts flakes in its left slot and exports Forge Energy from its sides. One flake yields 4000 FE. A neighboring condenser receives the power without a cable. Connect another mod’s FE cables or generator if

pages.title: Condensing a sample
pages.text: The Essence Condenser consumes one dormant flake and 4000 FE to produce one assimilation essence. Processing takes ten seconds when powered. The right slot holds the result. Hoppers can supply raw input and take completed essence.

pages.title: Condensing a sample
pages.text: The full standalone loop therefore needs two flakes per essence: one for fuel, one for the sample. The machines themselves need only vanilla materials.

pages.title: Opening the field
pages.text: Later, sneak-use an attunement sigil on a charged condenser to reverse the Stillness locally. Opening requires a 4000 FE reserve; the open breach consumes 20 FE per tick. Refining pauses while it is open.

pages.title: Opening the field
pages.text: The breach reaches twenty-four blocks. Inside, live hearts can operate and contact infection is possible. Outside, home remains sheltered. Sneak-use the sigil again to close it; loss of power closes it safely. Living colonies

pages.title: Opening the field
pages.text: there become dormant. Liberated dimensions remain silent even inside an attempted breach.
